frase.texto: The Church offers herself in a way that helps to interpret reality in all its depth. She supports with humble firmness the choices that promote the dignity of every person, the cohesion of communities and the good of all.
frase.fuente: Encyclical Magnifica Humanitas, quoted by Cardinal Parolin at Pontifical Lateran University

fuente.titulo: Cardinal Parolin: Universities must help humanity navigate today's challenges - Vatican News

bajada: Encyclical Magnifica Humanitas, quoted by Cardinal Parolin at Pontifical Lateran University · 2026
caption:
“The Church offers herself in a way that helps to interpret reality in all its depth. She supports with humble firmness the choices that promote the dignity of every person, the cohesion of communities and the good of all.”

— Pope Leo XIV, Encyclical Magnifica Humanitas, quoted by Cardinal Parolin at Pontifical Lateran University (2026)

Via Vatican News, 26 November 2026
